tasks.short: Direct patrons to coatrooms and waiting areas

steps.what: Direct patrons to coatrooms or suitable waiting areas and answer immediate questions

tasks.design: Keep directions and immediate assistance with the host. Existing signs and {DOCS} venue information may support guests, but no measured removal of the host's situational help is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The appropriate direction depends on guests and current conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional digital input replaces direct assistance in this design.
tasks.still_hard: Accessibility needs, crowding and guests unfamiliar with the venue.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing when a simple direction is insufficient.
tasks.altitude: No change to guest assistance duties.

reach.task: Resolve waiting-area access or capacity problems
reach.learn: Which guest needs require a different arrangement

evidence.claim: The retained guest-direction task has no claimed software labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the host's directions and help, excluding guests' movement and reservation administration.
s1 includes observing occupancy and guest needs; no structured occupancy or accessibility flag is assumed.
No new customer capture, signage project or system upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Venue layout and typical guest assistance needs
research_questions: Are repeated fixed-direction questions a measured burden distinct from personal assistance?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100. All direct guest assistance remains with zero new upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare closing cash receipts and bank deposits

steps.what: Count closing cash and gather till receipts and cash movement records
outputs: counted cash totals and source records

steps.what: Prepare cash receipts summary and reconcile counted cash with expected takings
inputs: counted cash totals and source records

steps.what: Check deposit amount secure cash and make bank deposit under existing procedure
inputs: counted cash totals and source records
outputs: completed deposit and bank receipt or unresolved deposit issue

tasks.design: Configure closing reconciliation and receipt output in {OTHER} till software using the counted cash and existing transaction records. The host still counts money, investigates differences and checks and completes the physical bank deposit; no automated money movement is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Closing summaries repeat values from cash counts and till reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native closing reports can calculate expected cash and assemble a summary deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Unrecorded cash movements and discrepancies that arithmetic cannot explain.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when the cash and records do not justify a deposit amount.
tasks.altitude: Less summary preparation; custody and deposit responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve unexplained differences between closing records and bank receipts
reach.learn: How timing and cash movements affect reconciliation

evidence.claim: Native closing calculations can reduce summary copying while physical counting and discrepancy checks remain human; this is model knowledge, not a case in the reservations digest.

assumptions: Boundary is host closing and deposit work; finance posting and bank processing are unchanged outside it.
s1 counts cash and captures counted amount, currency, closing period, float and cash movement references; the host produces those inputs.
Existing till transactions are produced by staff during unchanged payment capture and supply tender, amount, timestamp, refund and transaction ID; no new transaction coding is assumed for free.
s2 retains manual input/matching and investigation of differences. Missing till data uses the current manual reconciliation rather than inferred takings.
Test native closing reports first; existing till arithmetic runtime earns no saving.
s3 retains full checking, cash custody, transport and deposit. Revised totals require a fresh deposit check.
unknowns: Current till reports, deposit procedure and actual manual summary burden
research_questions: Can native closing output reduce copying after counting all cash capture and difference investigation?

already_counted.description: Input/matching, reconciliation review and cash-difference investigation in s2
Deposit amount check and physical deposit in s3

incremental.description: Maintain closing settings and investigate report mismatches

approvals.approved_version: Exact closing period, counted cash, retained float, reconciled amount, deposit amount and destination; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+15+35=85; gross 15 minus 1 upkeep gives net 14. High requires manual closing-summary copying; low covers existing automation or differences consuming the benefit. Physical deposit time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect table and serving-station supplies and determine required replacements
Prepare order or requisition for table and serving-station supplies and equipment
Check quantities specifications and cost and submit authorised requisition

tasks.design: Configure approved repeat lines and station delivery defaults in {PROCUREMENT}. The host still inspects supplies, chooses quantities and checks the complete requisition before submitting it through the existing purchasing route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine supply requisitions repeat item and delivery details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and approved favourites can reuse existing information.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected service needs and whether a substitute is suitable.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing what is damaged, missing or unsuitable at the station.
tasks.altitude: Less requisition entry; physical checks and purchase authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve unavailable station supplies or unusual equipment needs
reach.learn: Which alternatives need service or budget approval

evidence.claim: Native repeat-line requisitions can reduce repeated entry; the task-specific saving is an unmeasured model assumption.

assumptions: Boundary is host requisition preparation/submission, excluding purchasing approval, supplier fulfilment and receiving.
s1 counts inspection and capture of station, required item/specification, quantity/unit and needed date; the host produces checked needs.
The existing buyer process produces approved item code, supplier, price/unit and terms; additional catalogue corrections have an upkeep allowance.
s2 retains matching, input entry and manual exceptions. No structured stock deficit or par level is assumed.
Test native favourites first. Missing catalogue data uses the current purchasing query route.
s3 checks the exact requisition version; changed quantities, items or delivery details require renewed approval.
unknowns: Catalogue coverage, repeat frequency and local requisition authority
research_questions: Do approved repeat lines save entry time without extra buyer corrections?

already_counted.description: Requisition entry/matching in s2 and complete submission check in s3

incremental.description: Maintain station defaults and inspect failed repeat lines

approvals.approved_version: Exact station, item/specification, quantities/units, supplier, cost, delivery details and requisition version; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+18+25=73; gross 27 minus 1.5 focal upkeep gives net 25.5. High needs repeated approved lines; low covers unusual items and missing data. Buyer upkeep is separate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hire train and supervise service staff

steps.what: Assess candidates and make authorised service-staff hiring recommendations or decisions
Train food and beverage service staff through demonstration practice and feedback
Supervise food and beverage staff and adjust direction during service

tasks.design: Retain candidate judgement, practical training and live supervision with the authorised host. Existing {HCM} and {DOCS} records may support the process, but no separate repeated administration baseline is invented inside these people activities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff selection and support depend on people and actual service behaviour.
tasks.enabler_now: No measured administrative subtask has been established for this graph.
tasks.still_hard: Fair hiring, adapting instruction and managing live service problems.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing concerns and judging what support a person needs.
tasks.altitude: No change to hiring, training or supervisory authority.

reach.task: Resolve staffing decisions beyond the host's authority
reach.learn: Which hiring and employee issues require manager involvement

evidence.claim: The proposed workflow retains human selection, practical training and supervision with no claimed automation saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the host's authorised contribution, excluding candidate effort, staff productive work and HR administration.
The host gathers and assesses relevant information during retained s1 time; no candidate ranking or worker score is assumed.
s2 and s3 count observation, communication and practical feedback without structured competence inputs.
No new system, transferred capture or ongoing upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Host hiring authority, training responsibilities and service staffing
research_questions: Is repeat administration separately measured from hiring conversations and practical supervision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+30+40=100. Hiring judgement, training and supervision retain their time with zero incremental upkeep.

reach: Give finance and purchasing colleagues checked records
